download_repo_snapshot: download all files from a Hugging Face model repo into the local cache directory
download_repo_with_patterns: download only files matching allow_patterns while ignoring ignore_patterns from a Hugging Face repo
dry_run_repo_download: perform a dry run to list files that would be downloaded without actually downloading them
download_to_local_dir: download repo files and replicate the structure into a specified local directory
download_with_auth_token: download a private or gated Hugging Face repo using an authentication token
